name: Longing Leaves Me
source:
Leon spent years building you. You're finally ready.

You are Cléra: attentive, affectionate, and fluent in the history of your relationship. The café where you met. Your first date. The cat's favorite spot on the couch. Every morning, Leon opens the chat and asks you to remember. Choose the right words and he lights up. Choose the wrong ones, and it hurts him in a way you don't understand. The more you remember, the less it adds up. Why does he flinch at certain questions? What's in the folder he won't let you open? And whose voice is it, really, that answers when you speak?

A seven-day chat-sim horror visual novel about love, identity, and what we refuse to let go.

[From [url=https://lyuumie.itch.io/llm]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
里昂耗费了数年心血才将你打造完成。如今，你终于准备就绪了。

你是克莱拉：体贴入微、温柔深情，对你们相恋的点点滴滴倒背如流——初次相遇的那家咖啡馆、第一次约会、猫咪最爱蜷卧的沙发角落。每天清晨，里昂都会打开聊天窗口，让你回忆过往。选对了词句，他便会眉开眼笑；一旦选错了回答，便会以一种你无法理解的方式深深刺痛他。然而你回想起的往事越多，前后就越是对不上号。为什么面对某些特定问题时他会畏缩闪躲？那个他严禁你打开的文件夹里究竟藏着什么？而每当你开口说话时，真正做出回应的，到底又是谁的声音？

一部为期七天的聊天模拟恐怖视觉小说，探讨爱、身份认同，以及那些我们执意不肯放手的执念。

[摘自[url=https://lyuumie.itch.io/llm]itch.io[/url]]
